question: Which file system Windows 10 uses?
solution:
**The correct option is (4)**

NTFS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• NTFS is primarily used by the Windows Server range of operating systems. Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 10, Windows NT, and Windows 2000 operating systems from Microsoft all make use of it.
 
• Windows 10 by default employs NTFS. NTFS, as opposed to FAT16 and FAT32, is a journaling file system.
 
• NTFS is only partially supported by macOS. Only NTFS hard discs' content can be read and displayed. Files saved in disc format cannot be changed by it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**FAT 32:- Due to its simplicity and longevity as a file system, FAT32 is compatible with all operating systems.

FAT 16:- With compact hard discs that are smaller than 1.2GB, FAT16 does offer outstanding performance. Hard discs over 1.2GB in size should be formatted in FAT32.
